title: Great tour & guide
text: Alfredo was an incredible guide! He was extremely knowledgeable and helpful with answering all sorts of questions. He managed to keep track of a big group and made us all feel accounted for and considered the whole time. He made the trip fun while learning a lot!
author: elorasharon

title: A Guided Tour Must!
text: Naomi did a phenomenal job on our tour today. Our tour happened to be on the day of the general strike, but she maintained such a positive and professional attitude. We were, thankfully, able to start our tour a little bit late and continue our wonderful tour. We learned so much and appreciated all that she had to share. We would highly recommend this tour.
author: Eric_J

title: Excellent tour
text: Excellent comprehensive tour of Alhambra and Nasrid Palace. Our tour started at 9am for 3 hours including the gardens. Highly recommend Tour guide Georgia who was very friendly and knowledgeable about the history, information and facts.  Very interesting and definitely worth a visit.
author: Dream300846

title: Exciting and knowledgeable tour.

title: An excellent guided tour
text: Guillaume "the Old" An exciting guide who takes great care of his clients. Perfect tour in every way with a lot of humor and generosity. He shared his passion for history with us with great enthusiasm. We will return at another time of the year with great pleasure.

title: Andalusia .. crossroads of empires
text: Nayra was a most wonderful guide! She extremely knowledgable on the history of Andalusia and Alhambra .. our tour was extremely relaxed and comprehensive .. Nayra answered questions and we had a most informative discussion on the history behind various parts of the Alhambra complex! The online booking was very easy and the admission fee was more than reasonable for the experience, as was the length of the tour! Thank you
